jobs.48ae98617556: Closing quotation mark or quote-plus-newline right after sentence-ending punctuation (." ?" ."), and the word "edited"/"Edit" as editing verb; top window is a closing quote after a period.
jobs.179da51cacbe: "of" in "one of the ..." (also "another of", "some of"), and sentence-initial "As" at the start of a paragraph or heading line.
jobs.c33c5a0b108c: Function word or modifier mid-phrase inside a coordinated or prepositional phrase ("in fact,", "as well as in", "and general", "second largest city in"), where a noun phrase continues next.
jobs.bb27c0dae491: Token inside a proper name, handle, acronym or title, right after its first piece: " @" before a Twitter handle, " HMS", " of" in "Republic of", name fragments.
jobs.17f393515a37: Linking verb "is"/"are"/"was"/"be" directly after a subject noun phrase, before the predicate ("The answer is", "the purpose of government is").
jobs.eec976f294d7: Word that continues a noun phrase or a "X as well as" / "is also" construction: "also", "wheat", "well", "test", "world", "land"; no single token type.
jobs.06888843dfc5: Sentence- or clause-initial quantity or size adjective starting a noun phrase: "High", "Most", "Heavy", "Little", "Large", "Old", "Recent", often after a period.
jobs.7fafa43be38a: Short conversational opener or contraction at the start of an answer or quoted reply: "I'm", "It's", "Well", "Yes,", "No", "Oh,", often following a question.
jobs.8e73b8b4a65c: First or middle sub-word piece of a rare word or name split across tokens (" th|ighbone", "Ung|arisch", " ac|etic", " lac|rimal"), plus an opening paren/bracket after a headword.
jobs.ec299305d6a5: Noun or determiner-like word after "The"/"this"/"the" that begins a described object ("command", "pattern", "following", "collection", "course"), or a closing quote/period ending a clause.
jobs.4bf795b723f1: Verbal noun or particle after "the/this/no/coming/carrying" forming a gerund phrase: "carrying out", "traveling", "no going back", "coming together", "observing".
jobs.51f0ae272fa7: Word-piece ending a long rare word or name, mostly the suffix "i", "in", "ic", "id" or " Wisconsin" after "University of" (BEAUTi, Sukhoi, erythropoietin, antioxidant).
jobs.8a7b1065466f: Preposition or number-scale word in the middle of a noun phrase: "transfer of", "450 million", "4.4 million", "in other words"; unclear which single token matters.
jobs.926673c088e0: unclear: first or middle sub-word piece of a rare word in poetry or line-broken text ("se|ethe", "y|awn", "und|ivided", "pancre|atitis"), word fragment before a newline-wrapped text.
jobs.fdc55b4aa878: Word fragment or ordinal/number token in a parallel list or technical name: " t|amarin", " Br|ucella", "tr|ichloro", "1|0", "second", "third", "T-62".
jobs.77fd2be68c9c: unclear: digit or short word in structured data (table cells, "Servings: 0", list numbers), and a pronoun/verb "can" after "they"; digit inside tables and numeric lists.
jobs.53a1014359b7: Mid-word piece of a person or place name, often an accented or non-ASCII character or digit inside a number/year ("B|ö|hringer", "1|9|50", "Winn|ie", Hebrew letters).
jobs.afe546a1d83c: News-agency or wire-service name inside the dateline parentheses at the start of an article: "(Reuters", "(ANI)", "(PhysOrg", "(AP)", "(HealthDay".
jobs.2791a40975fa: Final or middle word of a fixed title or proper-name phrase: "To Kill A Mockingbird", "Windows to the Universe", "Riders to the Sea", "Pray the Devil Back", "HealthDay".
jobs.09af392fdd5d: Noun completing a stock phrase after "the"/"that" ("not always the case", "feel that way", "to that fact", "hotly debated"), also a verb/adjective after a subject.
jobs.da73773a0f3f: Line break or table pipe "|" at the start of a new line/cell in web-scraped page layout (metadata, tables, post headers), and opening quote or dash at line start.
jobs.19651a1e4041: Newline or word right after a byline or page-title header ("By Gerald Forbes\n", "Education professor", "University of Alberta"), at the start of a document.
jobs.e7c222a6781d: Word in boilerplate or notice phrases near document start ("no longer being updated", "Embargoed for", "transgress|ions"), and digits or colons in date/time stamps.
jobs.c8e222bf78c9: Structural separator in infobox or label-list pages: "|", "•", "-" or newline starting a field line, and the word "Information" after "Bloom".
jobs.d16c3423ef32: Word right after a verb or noun of disguise, pretence or false appearance ("disguised as", "pretending to", "appear to", "accused", "claimed"): usually "as" or "to".
jobs.357e4d657614: Noun or closing paren in formal institutional or boilerplate phrases ("A service of", "Place of publication", "Respect for Integrity", "a copy of"); no single token type.
jobs.3808340ae65d: The word "the"/"The" (also "la") starting a noun phrase after a preposition, comma or at a line start, as in "countries that the U.S." or "closed to the public".
jobs.b96b53f534f7: Word after the first word of a capitalised name or title, at the start of a document or heading ("Lisa Al|calay", "World Social", "King c|obra"), and "and"/"or" between modifiers.
jobs.74c02db0e719: Token in citations, reference lists and catalogue ids: "of" in "Encyclopedia of"/"member of", first digit of an object name ("J0102"), reference-number punctuation.
jobs.b077f31efeef: Demonstrative or pronoun ("this", "these", "which", "it", "they", "the") right after "and"/"in turn" that opens a new clause continuing the prior sentence.
